text: Seven N=64, data_seed 0 seeds (20-26) now give final force margins of 0.215-0.261. If you pool them with their paired N=128 runs, is the per-seed N=64 minus N=128 trained force R2 drop (about 0.10-0.13 in seeds 24-26) more consistent across seeds than the margin drop? That would make trained R2 the better statistic for cross-N contrasts.
